title: Research audit: complete copied-information bills for P112 rank-five cuts (no new kappa)
body:
For the exact cost-seven P112 parent `[7,0]`, a rank-r rectangular cut and its full remainder require a symmetric binary information bill of at least `14+r` for r=1,...,6, even with shared encoding; each bound is attained. All 384 canonical rank-five cuts attaining1060 of 1260 frames have remainder rank12 and shared information rank12 on each source direction, giving24 instead of the original symmetric14. A separately copied cut/remainder costs17 on one orientation.

**Status: scoped information-rank audit and exact dirty binary fork construction; no new kappa or admitted complex supplier.** The stated contract requires both split packets, or both bilinear kernels under linear operand compression. Only requiring their sum, changing other terms or providing other-parent side information changes the contract. The complex native-interface mapping is an open obligation, not an inferred consequence of binary rank.

The written all-support proof uses a newly checked complementary-support property of the pinned parent. It also yields a sharp capacity step: rank-at-most-five cuts cover at most1020 frames with symmetric information budget 19–23, and at most1060 with budget 24 or more. Coverage domination is used only for coverage; completion-cost monotonicity is not assumed.

Validation completed:

- All 254 nonzero complementary supports and an independent 32258 codeword-intersection checks.
- Two separate implementations of the complete21463-candidate census, including13335 admitted cuts; all bills and the ordered stream digest agree.
- Exact rank-factorized forks:1200/1196 XORs,12 arbitrary dirty helpers per direction, all 348 input/helper/output columns, literal inverse recovery and omitted-erase controls.
- Sharp rank1–6/capacity witnesses, rank-seven identity countercontrol, registered replay, source metadata pins, selected-record integrity and diff checks.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-cut-completion-seed36
```

Expected: both engine PASS messages and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. The literal L=1 invoices include source/target access, helper restoration, instruction reads and both head returns; arbitrary-L arithmetic is lane-wise. Complete complex frames/allocations/precision/hosting and recursive supplier charges remain outside this artifact. The selected full cold replay was not run for the isolated audit; no selected construction or upstream file changes.

Exact base: `55a02580ce1b283026e9d3b3510b218f8c93a4de`; OS seed36, complex-supplier track. Credit woklerx's #1445 at `7af6f56bf9ed58eacb3164d7b87b1c92716d8f07` for the partial-cut capacity theorem, PR1347 for the original model/root order and the retained E8/copied-cost lineage. The related complex-rank completion #1447 is explicitly distinguished; no field transfer is assumed. No predecessor executable implementation is imported. Prepared by Cinna Davis (`1337isnot1337`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Claim: Discussion #1555. Human/Lean review remains separate.
